title: Marooned House
content: The old house in Columbus, Ohio was once part of a neighborhood. But the other houses are all gone.Now it stands alone. It looks out over parking lots and empty warehouses. Where once stood trees, now stand utility poles, street lights, cell towers and billboards.Maybe it’s haunted. Who knows, but anyway, Happy Halloween!Today, Monday, October 31, from 11-12:30,I'll be lecturingon  color, light, and composition at the Canzani Center Auditorium at the Columbus  College of Art and Design (CCAD) in Ohio. It's free and open to the  public.
